+"""Test Response as a dependency with Depends"""
+from typing import Annotated
+
+import pytest
+from fastapi import Depends, FastAPI
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+from starlette.responses import Response
+
+app = FastAPI()
+
+
+def modify_response() -> Response:
+    """Dependency that returns a Response object"""
+    response = Response(content="Modified by dependency", status_code=201)
+    response.headers["X-Custom-Header"] = "dependency-value"
+    return response
+
+
+def get_response_with_header() -> Response:
+    """Another dependency that returns a Response"""
+    response = Response(content="", status_code=200)
+    response.headers["X-Test"] = "test-value"
+    return response
+
+
+# Test case 1: Annotated with Depends
+@app.get("/test-annotated")
+def endpoint_annotated(response: Annotated[Response, Depends(modify_response)]):
+    """Test endpoint with Annotated Response dependency"""
+    return {"message": "success", "response_type": str(type(response).__name__)}
+
+
+# Test case 2: Default value with Depends
+@app.get("/test-default")
+def endpoint_default(response: Response = Depends(modify_response)):
+    """Test endpoint with default Response dependency"""
+    return {"message": "success", "response_type": str(type(response).__name__)}
+
+
+# Test case 3: Regular Response injection (should still work)
+@app.get("/test-regular")
+def endpoint_regular(response: Response):
+    """Test endpoint with regular Response injection"""
+    response.headers["X-Regular"] = "regular-value"
+    return {"message": "regular"}
+
+
+# Test case 4: Multiple dependencies
+@app.get("/test-multiple")
+def endpoint_multiple(
+    response1: Annotated[Response, Depends(modify_response)],
+    response2: Response = Depends(get_response_with_header),
+):
+    """Test endpoint with multiple Response dependencies"""
+    return {
+        "message": "multiple",
+        "response1_type": str(type(response1).__name__),
+        "response2_type": str(type(response2).__name__),
+    }
+
+
+client = TestClient(app)
+
+
+def test_annotated_response_dependency():
+    """Test Response with Annotated[Response, Depends(...)]"""
+    response = client.get("/test-annotated")
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    data = response.json()
+    assert data["message"] == "success"
+    assert data["response_type"] == "Response"
+
+
+def test_default_response_dependency():
+    """Test Response with default Depends(...)"""
+    response = client.get("/test-default")
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    data = response.json()
+    assert data["message"] == "success"
+    assert data["response_type"] == "Response"
+
+
+def test_regular_response_injection():
+    """Test that regular Response injection still works"""
+    response = client.get("/test-regular")
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.headers.get("X-Regular") == "regular-value"
+    data = response.json()
+    assert data["message"] == "regular"
+
+
+def test_multiple_response_dependencies():
+    """Test multiple Response dependencies"""
+    response = client.get("/test-multiple")
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    data = response.json()
+    assert data["message"] == "multiple"
+    assert data["response1_type"] == "Response"
+    assert data["response2_type"] == "Response"
